definitions.gloss: synthetic fiber; chemical fiber; man-made fiber
definitions.explanation: Fiber produced through chemical processes rather than occurring naturally. Includes both fully synthetic fibers like polyester and nylon, and semi-synthetic fibers like rayon.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦シャツ→シャツ：01052_shatsu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{化学繊維|かがくせんい}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦できている→できる：00557_dekiru⟧。
examples.english: This shirt is made of synthetic fiber.

examples.japanese: {化学繊維|かがくせんい}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{乾|かわ}き→乾く：00786_kawaku⟧やすい⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{特徴|とくちょう}→特徴：03456_tokuchou⟧だ。
examples.english: A characteristic of synthetic fibers is that they dry quickly.

examples.japanese: {天然繊維|てんねんせんい}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{化学繊維|かがくせんい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{混|ま}ぜた→混ぜる：02423_mazeru⟧⟦{素材|そざい}→素材：09492_sozai⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{多|おお}く→多い：01127_ooi⟧⟦{使|つか}われている→使う：00473_tsukau⟧。
examples.english: Materials that blend natural and synthetic fibers are widely used.

notes:
A compound of ⟦{化学|かがく}→化学：05336_kagaku_chem⟧ ('chemistry') and ⟦{繊維|せんい}→繊維：13857_seni⟧ ('fiber'). Often abbreviated to {化繊|かせん} in everyday speech. Covers a broad category including polyester (⟦ポリエステル→ポリエステル：26376_poriesuteru⟧), nylon (⟦ナイロン→ナイロン：20177_nairon⟧), acrylic (⟦アクリル→アクリル：28698_akuriru⟧), and rayon (レーヨン). Commonly encountered when shopping for clothing or discussing textiles.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {化学繊維|かがくせんい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{服|ふく}→服：00695_fuku⟧: synthetic clothing
- {化学繊維|かがくせんい}⟦{製|せい}→〜製：02001_sei⟧: made of synthetic fiber
- ⟦{合成|ごうせい}{繊維|せんい}→合成繊維：22280_gouseiseni⟧: synthetic fiber (near-synonym)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {化繊|かせん}: synthetic fiber — the common abbreviation
- {天然繊維|てんねんせんい}: natural fiber — the opposite: cotton, wool, silk, etc.
- ⟦{合成繊維|ごうせいせんい}→合成繊維：22280_gouseiseni⟧: synthetic fiber — a near-synonym that specifically refers to fully artificial fibers (excluding semi-synthetics like rayon)
